exit_messages.1: DataGrip could not open or fill the connection window. Close any open connection dialogs and retry.
exit_messages.2: Enable JumpServer in macOS Privacy & Security → Accessibility, then retry.
exit_messages.3: Invalid database connection or unsupported DataGrip application bundle.
exit_messages.4: Complete the initial setup in DataGrip or install the database driver if prompted, then retry.
